name: Imperium Veldoria
startIntroPart1: Hail, Sovereign Player of the mighty Imperium Veldoria! Born from the depths and masters of the endless seas, your people have tamed the ocean currents to build an imperial stronghold.
startIntroPart2: O Great Player, your fleet stands ready and your people look toward the horizon. Will you spread the dominance of Veldoria across all lands and oceans?
declaringWar: The depths demand your surrender! Face the wrath of Veldoria!
attacked: You dare challenge the tides? The ocean will swallow your armies whole.
defeated: The empire sinks into legend... but the tides will eventually return.
introduction: I am Player, ruler of Imperium Veldoria. State your business before the sea claims your ships.
neutralHello: Greetings, traveler of the high seas.
hateHello: Why are you trespassing in Veldorian waters?!
tradeRequest: The ocean offers wealth to those wise enough to bargain with Veldoria.
